# X08 cycle 3, boot 5 on g2: the APFS volume the host made (WBHost) as the
# guest sees it, and a blank internal disk the guest formats HFS+ (WBHfs),
# which has no encryption at rest. Throwaway.
set -u
diskutil list | grep -E '^/dev|WB'
echo "-- WBHost as the guest sees it:"
diskutil info WBHost | grep -E 'Device Identifier|Mounted|Mount Point|Owners|FileVault|Encrypt|Device Location|Locked'
diskutil apfs list | grep -A10 'Name: *WBHost' | grep -E 'FileVault|Encrypt'
mount | grep -i wbhost
blank=""
for d in $(diskutil list | awk -F"[/ ]" '/^\/dev\/disk/{print $3}'); do
  info=$(diskutil info $d 2>/dev/null) || continue
  echo "$info" | grep -q 'Media Name: *Apple Inc. VirtIO Block Media' || continue
  echo "$info" | grep -q 'Content (IOContent): *None' && blank=$d
done
echo "blank disk: ${blank:-none}"
[ -n "$blank" ] || exit 1
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
diskutil eraseDisk JHFS+ WBHfs GPT $blank
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME format HFS+ $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
diskutil info WBHfs | grep -E 'Device Identifier|Mount Point|Owners|FileVault|Encrypt|File System Personality|Device Location'
mount | grep -i wbhfs
true

# data3.img). Users made on g2 (boot 5), recreated on g3 (boot 6) from this
# host state. name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID

wbr1 621 621 B5E85314-4A02-4E80-9475-67A94E872BE3 32AB5FCD-9EB3-409E-8E67-2B3AA9203E30
wbr2 622 622 63DA8CD6-4BE9-4CB5-A74B-B1554D13C480 E3906395-A9B0-4D0E-89B0-29526C459D81
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhomes
H=$HOMES U1=wbr1 U2=wbr2 VOLNAME=WBHost

# its name ($VOLNAME), move it from wherever Disk Arbitration put it to the
# fixed mount point $H outside /Volumes (cycle 1: a /Volumes point can't be
# mounted on again), with nobrowse, nosuid and nodev unless SUID=1, and
# with ownership on: the owners mount option, then diskutil enableOwnership,
# which an external volume needs again on a new system disk. Throwaway.
set -u

vol=$(diskutil info "$VOLNAME" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Device Identifier/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')

[ -n "$vol" ] || exit 1
echo "before: $(mount | grep "^/dev/$vol " || echo 'not mounted')"
diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Owners|Locked|FileVault'
diskutil unmount "$vol" >/dev/null 2>&1
# An unmount locks a passphrase volume again, so unlock after it.
if [ -n "${PASS:-}" ] && diskutil info "$vol" | grep -q 'Locked: *Yes'; then
  printf '%s' "$PASS" | diskutil apfs unlockVolume "$vol" -stdinpassphrase -nomount
  diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Locked'
fi
mkdir -p "$H"
opts=nobrowse,nosuid,nodev,owners
[ "${SUID:-0}" = 1 ] && opts=nobrowse,owners
diskutil mount -mountOptions "$opts" -mountPoint "$H" "$vol"
echo "mounted: $(mount | grep " $H ")"
diskutil enableOwnership "$H"
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME mount $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
echo "after: $(mount | grep "^/dev/$vol ")"
diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Owners|Mount Point'
ls -lan "$H"

set -u

printf '{"type":"user","message":"hello from %s"}\n' "$n" > .claude/projects/wb-project/c1.jsonl
link=$(echo "$HOME/sessions/s1" | sed 's/[^A-Za-z0-9]/-/g')
ln -s ../../.claude/projects/wb-project ".claude/projects/$link"
printf '{"numStartups":3,"projects":{"%s/sessions/s1":{"allowedTools":["Bash(git status)"]}}}\n' "$HOME" > .claude.json
chmod 600 .claude.json .claude/settings.json
echo secret-ish > m600; chmod 600 m600
echo public > m644; chmod 644 m644
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho run\n' > m755; chmod 755 m755
echo ro > m400; chmod 400 m400
mkdir d750; chmod 750 d750
xattr -w org.wraithbox.x08 "xattr-$n" m644
xattr -w com.apple.quarantine "0081;00000000;x08;" m755
echo acl > acl-file
chmod +a "group:$n allow read" acl-file
echo acl2 > acl-deny
chmod +a "user:$n deny write,append,writeattr,writeextattr,delete" acl-deny
ln -s m644 link-to-m644
echo flagged > uchg-file; chflags uchg uchg-file
dd if=/dev/urandom of=big.bin bs=1m count=64 2>/dev/null
security create-keychain -p "kc-$n" "$HOME/Library/Keychains/x08.keychain-db"
security add-generic-password -a "$n" -s x08-item -w "item-$n" "$HOME/Library/Keychains/x08.keychain-db"
echo "$n keychain item: $(security find-generic-password -s x08-item -w "$HOME/Library/Keychains/x08.keychain-db")"
echo "$n append to acl-deny: $( (echo x >> acl-deny) 2>/dev/null && echo ALLOWED || echo refused)"
EOF
chmod 644 /tmp/x08-fill-user.sh
for n in $U1 $U2; do
  sudo -u $n -H /bin/sh /tmp/x08-fill-user.sh 2>&1
done
cp /var/root/euid $H/$U2/suid-euid
chown root:wheel $H/$U2/suid-euid
chmod 4755 $H/$U2/suid-euid
ls -l $H/$U2/suid-euid
sync

# X08 cycle 3b: homes on an HFS+ volume the guest formats on g2 (boot 5,
# data4.img), recreated on g3 (boot 6).
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbs1 631 631 03BEAC8D-42A1-4880-9906-6B2780AF6D66 9E338F45-5656-4673-9091-A11D2E2D4EBA
wbs2 632 632 B75A7ED7-5ECC-4E6D-92DC-2F5710A2E7BD 37D00E7A-78E9-463F-A097-EB9F22D1ED60
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhfs
H=$HOMES U1=wbs1 U2=wbs2 VOLNAME=WBHfs
# X08: a comparable snapshot of the homes on the data volume: numeric owner,
# group, mode, flags, size, ACL (as ls prints it), xattrs, and a checksum of
# every regular file. Times are left out: they differ by design. Throwaway.
set -u
H=${H:-/Volumes/wbhomes}
cd $H || exit 1
find ${U1:-wbp1} ${U2:-wbp2} -print | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r p; do
  st=$(stat -f '%u %g %Sp %Sf %z' "$p")
  case $(stat -f '%HT' "$p") in
    "Regular File") sum=$(shasum -a 256 "$p" | cut -c1-16) ;;
    "Symbolic Link") sum="-> $(readlink "$p")" ;;
    *) sum=- ;;
  esac
  [ -d "$p" ] && st=$(stat -f '%u %g %Sp %Sf' "$p")
  echo "$p $st $sum"
  ls -lde "$p" | sed -n '2,$p' | sed 's/^/    acl/'
  xattr "$p" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    xattr /'
done
